title: File:HSV Swift brings training, medical care to Liberia 120807-F-YW322-286.jpg
description: Liberian citizens walk to see medical professionals from Operation Onward Liberty, the U.S. Navy and the non-governmental organization Project Hope at a community outreach health fair here, Aug. 7.
